# Decode GPU kernel attribution — production NVFP4 + EAGLE-3 (D7 chain verify)

**source trace**: `outputs/profile_prod_20260511/1778458981.8711326-TP-0.trace.json.gz` (9.4 MB)
**workload**: single chat "Count from 1 to 200, comma-separated" (200 max_tokens), preceded by 1 warmup chat
**git HEAD**: `b7984d7` (demosala-rollback)
**measured**: 2026-05-11 08:23

## Top GPU kernel families (decode 全局)

| family | wall (ms) | count | % | 状态 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| **target/draft Marlin W4A16 GEMM** | 403.887 | 11936 | **62.6%** | 已优化（R-blog-tile lock-in）|
| **BF16 cutlass GEMM/lm_head** (sm_80 WMMA!) | **101.528** | 448 | **15.7%** | 🎯 **未量化, 新候选** |
| GLA target-verify recurrent | 27.642 | 1536 | 4.3% | 已 fused（`SGLANG_MINICPM_FUSED_GLA_QK_NORM_ROPE_OOP=1`）|
| FlashInfer attention/norm | 21.787 | 4711 | 3.4% | |
| Torch topk (spec sampler) | 20.740 | 9896 | 3.2% | 9896 launches, 2.1 µs/launch, launch-bound |
| gemvx (BF16 attention) | 13.603 | 65 | 2.1% | std attention 路径 |
| Torch index/gather/scatter | 13.315 | 2800 | 2.1% | KV pool / verify mask |
| RMSNorm | 13.307 | 5761 | 2.1% | 5761 launches, 2.3 µs/launch |
| GLA other (draft path) | 11.603 | 3120 | 1.8% | |
| reduce_kernel | 5.150 | 1560 | 0.8% | |
| direct_copy | 4.812 | 3282 | 0.7% | |
| add elementwise | 4.417 | 4160 | 0.7% | |
| Softmax | 4.253 | 384 | 0.7% | |
| _copy_mamba_verify_state | 3.470 | 64 | 0.5% | EAGLE verify state copy |
| 其他细碎 | ~15 | many | ~2% | |

**总 GPU wall ≈ 645 ms**

## lm_head 详细分解

3 个 cutlass `sm_80 WMMA tensorop bf16` 变体 (sm_80 fallback, 非 sm_120 native):

| kernel | calls | wall | µs/call |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `cutlass_80_wmma_tensorop_bf16_s161616gemm_bf16_16x16_128x2_tn_align8` | 320 | 64.88 ms | 203 |
| `cutlass_80_wmma_tensorop_bf16_s161616gemm_bf16_32x32_128x1_tn_align8` | 64 | 29.67 ms | 464 |
| `cutlass_80_wmma_tensorop_s161616gemm_bf16_32x32_128x1_tn_align8` (output 不同) | 63 | 6.88 ms | 109 |
| `cutlass_80_tensorop_bf16_s16816gemm_relu_bf16_128x64_64x3_tn_align8` | 1 | 0.09 ms | 90 |
| total | **448** | **101.5 ms** | — |

## lm_head 权重事实

```
lm_head.weight  shape=(73448, 4096) dtype=torch.bfloat16
embed_tokens.weight  shape=(73448, 4096) dtype=torch.bfloat16
```

**未量化**. 602 MB BF16 weight, 远超 112 MB sm_120 L2。

config.json `quantization_config.quant_algo=NVFP4` 应用到 attention/mlp linear，**不含 lm_head**（modelopt 默认行为：lm_head 跳过量化以保 sampler 数值稳定）.

## 攻击空间

EAGLE-3 D7 chain verify 每 decode iter 需要 ~8 次 lm_head（1 target + 7 draft），总 lm_head call = 200 gen tok / accept_len 3.43 × 8 ≈ 466（与实测 448 一致）.

**Per-call SOL 估算** (memory bound):
- weight load: 73448 × 4096 × 2B = 602 MB
- sm_120 BW = 1.6 TB/s
- SOL = 376 µs/call (cold load)

256	  // Verify K/N are divisible by thread K/N
257	  if (prob_k % th_config.thread_k != 0 || prob_n % th_config.thread_n != 0) {

459	exec_config_t determine_exec_config(
460	    const sglang::ScalarType& q_type,
461	    int prob_m,
462	    int prob_n,
463	    int prob_k,
464	    int thread_m_blocks,
465	    bool m_block_size_8,
466	    int num_bits,
467	    int group_size,

469	    bool is_k_full,

474	  exec_config_t exec_cfg = exec_config_t{1, thread_config_t{-1, -1, -1}};
475	  thread_config_t* thread_configs = thread_m_blocks > 1 ? large_batch_thread_configs : small_batch_thread_configs;
476	  int thread_configs_size = thread_m_blocks > 1 ? sizeof(large_batch_thread_configs) / sizeof(thread_config_t)
477	                                                : sizeof(small_batch_thread_configs) / sizeof(thread_config_t);
478	
479	  // R-blog-tile: env-var override (0/1/2 pin) + N-aware preferred order for large_batch
480	  // 实证 (2026-05-11 marlin_tile_sweep.py)：sm_120 + NVFP4 marlin large_batch path 上
481	  //   N ≤ 8192     → idx2 (tk=128, tn=64,  t=128) 比 default 快 17-37% (M=32-48)
482	  //   N=12288      → idx1 (tk=64,  tn=128, t=128) 比 default 快 7% (M=48)
483	  //   N ≥ 32768    → default (tk=64, tn=256, t=256) 最优（小 N tile 反而 SM 过度切分）
484	  // small_batch (thread_m_blocks=1) 在所有 N 上 default 都最优，不动。
485	  const char* force_env = std::getenv(thread_m_blocks > 1 ? "SGLANG_MARLIN_LB_FORCE_IDX" : "SGLANG_MARLIN_SB_FORCE_IDX");
486	  int force_idx = (force_env && force_env[0] != '\0') ? std::atoi(force_env) : -1;
487	
488	  // 静态优先级序列：依据 force_idx / large_batch + N 决定遍历顺序
489	  int order[3] = {0, 1, 2};  // default
490	  if (force_idx < 0 && thread_m_blocks > 1) {
491	    if (prob_n <= 8192)        { order[0] = 2; order[1] = 1; order[2] = 0; }
492	    else if (prob_n <= 16384)  { order[0] = 1; order[1] = 2; order[2] = 0; }
493	    // else (N >= 24576) keep {0, 1, 2}
494	  }
495	  bool order_valid = (thread_configs_size == 3);  // safety guard
496	
497	  for (int oi = 0; oi < thread_configs_size; oi++) {
498	    int i = order_valid ? order[oi] : oi;
499	    if (force_idx >= 0 && i != force_idx) continue;
500	    thread_config_t th_config = thread_configs[i];
501	
502	    if (!is_valid_config(
503	            th_config,
504	            thread_m_blocks,
505	            prob_m,
506	            prob_n,
507	            prob_k,
508	            num_bits,
509	            group_size,

512	            has_zp,
513	            is_zp_float,
514	            max_shared_mem)) {
515	      continue;
516	    }
517	
518	    int cache_size = get_kernel_cache_size(
519	        th_config,
520	        thread_m_blocks,
521	        prob_m,
522	        prob_n,
523	        prob_k,
524	        num_bits,
525	        group_size,
526	        has_act_order,
527	        is_k_full,
528	        has_zp,
529	        is_zp_float);
530	
531	    int group_blocks = 0;
532	    if (!has_act_order) {
533	      group_blocks = group_size == -1 ? -1 : group_size / 16;
534	    }
535	
536	    auto kernel = get_marlin_kernel<scalar_t>(
537	        q_type,
538	        thread_m_blocks,
539	        th_config.thread_n / 16,
540	        th_config.thread_k / 16,
541	        m_block_size_8,
542	        has_act_order,
543	        has_zp,

546	        is_zp_float);

554	    return {1, th_config};
555	  }

557	  return exec_cfg;

196	## Q. R-blog-tile-v2 — 加 Marlin LB idx3 = `{tk=64, tn=128, t=256}` 配置无效（kernel 越界写）（2026-05-11）
197	
198	**假设**：idx1 NUM_THREADS 128→256 变体在 issue rate / warp scheduling 角度优。
199	
200	**Patch**（已回滚）：`gptq_marlin.cu` 加 `{64,128,256}` + N=12288 段 `order[3]=3`。
201	
202	**microbench 假胜 + CUDA illegal memory access cascade**：gate_up/down M=32 idx3 vs default **-14~-16%**（phantom）。`down_proj M=48 idx3` 30 trials σ=0.63 无异常 — 看起来真胜。但下次 launch (`qkv_proj_std M=1`) 立即 `CUDA error: illegal memory access`，**整个 CUDA context 污染**。
203	
204	**根因**：idx3 `(THREAD_N_BLOCKS=8, THREAD_K_BLOCKS=4, NUM_THREADS=256)` **不是 valid Marlin 配置**。Marlin 内部 (warps×N×K) 不变式可能假设 NUM_THREADS=128，模板实例化编译期合法但 runtime 写出 buffer。"巨胜"是 kernel 做了错误 work，CUDA error 是 async illegal 在 next launch 同步报出。
205	
206	**关键教训**：**microbench timing 通过 ≠ kernel 正确**。新 tile 必须 (1) 数值 vs upstream-validated bit-exact (2) 后续 launch 无 illegal access (3) 多 shape cross-test 无污染。
207	
208	**SOP**：新 Marlin tile 候选必须从 upstream vLLM marlin commit history 抓；microbench 加 sentinel check（每 trial 后跑独立 `torch.zeros` 哨兵）；timing >10% kernel-level 增益必须警惕。
209	
210	**弃用**：Marlin LB idx3 `(8,4,256)`；microbench σ 小=正确；ad-hoc `(N,K,NUM_THREADS)` 组合。

344	    if key in BEST_TILE:
345	        return BEST_TILE[key]
346	    # fallback: scan buckets downward for same (N, K)
347	    for b2 in reversed(_M_BUCKETS):

349	            return BEST_TILE[(N, K, b2)]
350	    # unknown shape: conservative default
351	    return (64, 128, False)

354	def resolve_dispatch(N: int, K: int, M: int) -> str:
355	    """Return 'marlin', 'b12x', or 'cutlass' for this (N, K, M).
356	
357	    Assumes b12x_available() is True.
358	    """
359	    th = MARLIN_UPPER.get((N, K))
360	    if th is None:
361	        return "unknown"
362	    if M <= th:
363	        return "marlin"
364	    if (N, K, _bucket_m(M)) in CUTLASS_OVERRIDE:
365	        return "cutlass"
366	    return "b12x"
367

370	
371	def _compile_kernel(M: int, N: int, K: int, tile_mn: Tuple[int, int], use_prefetch: bool):
372	    import cutlass
373	    import cutlass.cute as cute
374	    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_ptr
375	    from flashinfer.cute_dsl.utils import get_max_active_clusters
376	    from .b12x.dense_blockscaled_gemm_sm120 import Sm120BlockScaledDenseGemmKernel
377	
378	    sf_vec_size = 16
379	    batch_size = 1
380	    cluster_shape_mn = (1, 1)
381	    sf_m = (M + 127) // 128
382	    sf_n = (N + 127) // 128
383	    sf_k = (K // sf_vec_size + 3) // 4
384	    c_cute_dtype = cutlass.BFloat16  # bf16 output only (matches SALA forward)
385	
386	    gemm = Sm120BlockScaledDenseGemmKernel(
387	        sf_vec_size, tile_mn, cluster_shape_mn, use_prefetch, True
388	    )
389	    sym_m, sym_k, sym_n = cute.sym_int(), cute.sym_int(), cute.sym_int()
390	    a_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
391	        cutlass.Uint8, (sym_m, sym_k), stride_order=(1, 0), assumed_align=32
392	    )
393	    b_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
394	        cutlass.Uint8, (sym_n, sym_k), stride_order=(1, 0), assumed_align=32
395	    )
396	    c_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
397	        c_cute_dtype, (sym_m, sym_n), stride_order=(1, 0), assumed_align=16
398	    )
399	    a_sf_ptr_fake = make_ptr(cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, 16, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, 16)
400	    b_sf_ptr_fake = make_ptr(cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, 16, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, 16)
401	    alpha_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(
402	        cutlass.Float32, (1,), assumed_align=4
403	    )
404	    max_ac = get_max_active_clusters(1)
405	    stream_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=True)
406	
407	    compiled = cute.compile(
408	        gemm.wrapper,
409	        a_fake, b_fake, c_fake,
410	        sf_m, sf_n, sf_k, batch_size,
411	        a_sf_ptr_fake, b_sf_ptr_fake, alpha_fake,
412	        max_ac, stream_fake, False,
413	        options="--opt-level 2 --enable-tvm-ffi",
414	    )

472	    x_fp4: torch.Tensor,        # (M, K/2) uint8, NVFP4 packed
473	    w_fp4: torch.Tensor,        # (N, K/2) uint8, NVFP4 packed (row-major)
474	    x_sf: torch.Tensor,         # block scales for A, uint8/fp8e4m3
475	    w_sf: torch.Tensor,         # block scales for B, uint8/fp8e4m3
476	    alpha: torch.Tensor,        # scalar fp32, shape (1,)
477	    out_dtype: torch.dtype = torch.bfloat16,
478	) -> torch.Tensor:

482	
483	    tile_m, tile_n, use_prefetch = _resolve_tile(N, K, M)

486	        M_bucket, N, K, (tile_m, tile_n), use_prefetch
487	    )
488

492	        sf_m, sf_n, sf_k,
493	        x_sf.data_ptr(), w_sf.data_ptr(),
494	        alpha,
495	    )
496	
497	    return out

500	def precompile_all(shapes_and_m: list[Tuple[int, int, int]]) -> int:
501	    """Eagerly compile a batch of (N, K, M) kernels. Used at server warmup.
502	
503	    Returns number of kernels successfully compiled.
504	    """
505	    if not b12x_available():
506	        return 0
507	    n_ok = 0
508	    for N, K, M in shapes_and_m:
509	        try:
510	            tile_mn = _resolve_tile(N, K, M)
511	            _get_cached_kernel(_bucket_m(M), N, K, tile_mn[:2], tile_mn[2])
512	            n_ok += 1
513	        except Exception as e:
514	            logger.warning("[b12x] precompile failed for N=%d K=%d M=%d: %s",
515	                          N, K, M, e)
516	    return n_ok

"""

    # allocate the output tensor if not provided
    if out is None:
        out = torch.empty(
            (a.shape[0], b.shape[1]),
            device=a.device,
            dtype=out_dtype,
        )

    workspace_buffer = _get_cache_buf(
        "mm_fp4_workspace", DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_SIZE, a.device
    )

    # Auto-select the best backend
    if backend == "auto":
        backends = mm_fp4.suitable_auto_backends
    else:
        backends = [backend]

    # At this point, backends contains a supported backend if specified, or all supported backends if backend='auto'.
    # Lazy initialization of runners to avoid overhead of creating a new runner that will not be used
    major, minor = get_compute_capability(a.device)

    backend_to_runner_factory = {
        "cudnn": lambda: _cudnn_gemm_fp4_runner(),
        "trtllm": lambda: get_trtllm_gemm_module().trtllm_fp4_gemm_runner(
            use_8x4_sf_layout
        ),

        "cute-dsl": lambda: _cute_dsl_gemm_fp4_runner(
            major, minor, enable_pdl, out_dtype, use_nvfp4
        ),
    }
    runners = [backend_to_runner_factory[cur_backend]() for cur_backend in backends]

    # Now we have a list of runners for desired & supported backends.
    tuner = AutoTuner.get()

    tuning_config = (
        _MM_FP4_TUNING_CONFIG_8x4 if use_8x4_sf_layout else _MM_FP4_TUNING_CONFIG_128x4
    )

    inputs = [
        a,
        b,
        a_descale,
        b_descale,
        alpha,
        out_dtype,
        out,
        block_size,
        use_nvfp4,
        workspace_buffer,
    ]
    runner, tactic = tuner.choose_one(
        "fp4_gemm",
        runners,
        tuning_config,
        inputs,
    )

    runner(inputs=inputs, tactic=tactic)
    return out

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# =============================================================
# mini_bench.sh — 快速速度验证
#
# 用法:
#   bash bench/mini_bench.sh [API_BASE] [N_S1] [N_S8] [N_SMAX]
#
# 默认值:
#   API_BASE = http://127.0.0.1:30000
#   N_S1=8  N_S8=24  N_SMAX=64
#
# S8=24 覆盖三个满批，能体现并发压力；Smax=64 覆盖长尾。
# 数据集嵌套关系: S1(8) ⊆ S8(24) ⊆ Smax(64)，每档样本唯一。
# 本脚本取各档前 N 条，保留与全量相同的长尾特性。
# =============================================================

API_BASE="${1:-http://127.0.0.1:30000}"
N_S1="${2:-12}"
N_S8="${3:-36}"
N_SMAX="${4:-96}"

BENCH_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DATA_DIR="${BENCH_DIR}/data_full"
TOOLKIT_BENCH="${BENCH_DIR}/../toolkit/bench_serving.sh"

echo "=========================================================="
echo "  mini_bench  S1=${N_S1}  S8=${N_S8}  Smax=${N_SMAX}"
echo "  API: ${API_BASE}"
echo "=========================================================="

# 分层抽样到 /tmp（按 prompt_tokens 分布均匀取样，避免前段全是短请求）
S1_MINI="/tmp/mini_s1.jsonl"
S8_MINI="/tmp/mini_s8.jsonl"
SMAX_MINI="/tmp/mini_smax.jsonl"

python3 - <<PY
import json, random

SEED = 42

def stratified_sample(src, dst, n):
    if n <= 0:
        open(dst, 'w').close()  # empty file
        return
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    items = [json.loads(l) for l in open(src)]
    items.sort(key=lambda x: x['prompt_tokens'])
    step = len(items) / n
    sampled = [rng.choice(items[int(i*step):int((i+1)*step) or len(items)]) for i in range(n)]

82	def _compile_b12x(M, N, K, mma_tiler_mn, use_prefetch):
83	    sf_vec_size = 16
84	    sf_m = (M + 127) // 128

116	def bench_b12x(M, N, K, tile, prefetch):
117	    """Time one (shape, tactic) on b12x. Returns median ms over N_TRIALS."""
118	    compiled, sf_m, sf_n, sf_k = _compile_b12x(M, N, K, tile, prefetch)
119	
120	    # Inputs
121	    x_bf16 = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
122	    xq, xs = fp4_quantize(x_bf16, torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda"))
123	    W_u8 = torch.randint(0, 256, (N, K // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
124	    Mp, Kp = pad_up(N, 128), pad_up(K // 16, 4)
125	    Ws = torch.randint(0, 256, (Mp, Kp), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda").view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).contiguous()
126	    xs_c = xs.contiguous()
127	    alpha = torch.tensor([1.0], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
128	    out = torch.empty((M, N), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
129	
130	    def run():

132	
133	    # warmup + verify
134	    for _ in range(WARMUP):

137

141	        e = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
142	        s.record()
143	        for _ in range(ITERS):
144	            run()
145	        e.record()
146	        e.synchronize()
147	        times.append(s.elapsed_time(e) / ITERS)

181	
182	**假设**：M=8192 prefill 占 cutlass 95%+；microbench b12x 在 M∈{1024,2048,4096,8192} 普遍 +2%~78%（std_o M=2048 1.78×）。

191

196	## Q. R-blog-tile-v2 — 加 Marlin LB idx3 = `{tk=64, tn=128, t=256}` 配置无效（kernel 越界写）（2026-05-11）
197	
198	**假设**：idx1 NUM_THREADS 128→256 变体在 issue rate / warp scheduling 角度优。
199	
200	**Patch**（已回滚）：`gptq_marlin.cu` 加 `{64,128,256}` + N=12288 段 `order[3]=3`。
201	
202	**microbench 假胜 + CUDA illegal memory access cascade**：gate_up/down M=32 idx3 vs default **-14~-16%**（phantom）。`down_proj M=48 idx3` 30 trials σ=0.63 无异常 — 看起来真胜。但下次 launch (`qkv_proj_std M=1`) 立即 `CUDA error: illegal memory access`，**整个 CUDA context 污染**。
203	
204	**根因**：idx3 `(THREAD_N_BLOCKS=8, THREAD_K_BLOCKS=4, NUM_THREADS=256)` **不是 valid Marlin 配置**。Marlin 内部 (warps×N×K) 不变式可能假设 NUM_THREADS=128，模板实例化编译期合法但 runtime 写出 buffer。"巨胜"是 kernel 做了错误 work，CUDA error 是 async illegal 在 next launch 同步报出。
205	
206	**关键教训**：**microbench timing 通过 ≠ kernel 正确**。新 tile 必须 (1) 数值 vs upstream-validated bit-exact (2) 后续 launch 无 illegal access (3) 多 shape cross-test 无污染。
207	
208	**SOP**：新 Marlin tile 候选必须从 upstream vLLM marlin commit history 抓；microbench 加 sentinel check（每 trial 后跑独立 `torch.zeros` 哨兵）；timing >10% kernel-level 增益必须警惕。
209	
210	**弃用**：Marlin LB idx3 `(8,4,256)`；microbench σ 小=正确；ad-hoc `(N,K,NUM_THREADS)` 组合。

> AGENT

**Key finding**: Upstream sm_100 reference has NO cap; b12x sm_120 cap=4 is a port-time choice, not a hardware constraint.

**SMEM math** (sm_120 = 101376 bytes, occupancy=1):
- tile (64,64,128): ab_stage natural ≈ 8 → capped to 4 (40 KB SMEM wasted)
- tile (64,128,128): natural ≈ 5 → capped to 4 (14 KB wasted)
- tile (128,128,128): natural ≈ 3 → no cap binding

Patch hypothesis: bump cap 4→8 would benefit small-tile shapes (std_o, std_qkv, down → 64×64 path) most. Let me first do correctness + microbench experiment with the cap lifted, before any e2e.

cute.AddressSpace.gmem, 16)\n    alpha_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(cutlass.Float32, (1,), assumed_align=4)\n    max_ac = get_max_active_clusters(1)\n    stream_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=True)\n    compiled = cute.compile(\n        gemm.wrapper, a_fake, b_fake, c_fake, sf_m, sf_n, sf_k, 1,\n        a_sf_ptr_fake, b_sf_ptr_fake, alpha_fake, max_ac, stream_fake, False,\n        options=\"--opt-level 2 --enable-tvm-ffi\",\n    )\n    return compiled, sf_m, sf_n, sf_k, gemm.ab_stage\n\n\ndef pad_up(x, m):\n    return (x + m - 1) // m * m\n\n\n# A single small representative shape (M=64, N=64, K=128, tile=(64,64))\n# Use bf16 → fp4 quantize for activation; use *valid* SF for weight (= 1.0 fp8 e4m3 = 0x38 byte)\ndef main():\n    M, N, K = 256, 256, 256\n    tile = (64, 64); pf = False\n    comp_def, sf_m, sf_n, sf_k, st_def = compile_kernel(\n        b12x_default.Sm120BlockScaledDenseGemmKernel, M, N, K, tile, pf)\n    comp_pat, _, _, _, st_pat = compile_kernel(\n        b12x_patched.Sm120BlockScaledDenseGemmKernel, M, N, K, tile, pf)\n\n    print(f\"shape M={M} N={N} K={K} tile={tile}\")\n    print(f\"  ab_stage: default={st_def}  patched={st_pat}\")\n\n    # Valid activations: small bf16 range so FP4 quant stays in normal numeric range\n    torch.manual_seed(42)\n    x_bf16 = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=\"cuda\") * 0.1\n    g_scale = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device=\"cuda\")\n    xq, xs = fp4_quantize(x_bf16, g_scale)\n    xs_c = xs.contiguous()\n\n    # Valid weights: small random fp4 values represented as packed uint8\n    # Use sgl_kernel quantize too for weight to keep it physically valid\n    w_bf16 = torch.randn(N, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, 746	        s, e = _evt_record("mlp_down_ms"); x, _ = self.down_proj(x); _evt_end(e)

60	"""
61	This example provides an experimental implementation of the SM100 batched dense blockscaled GEMM kernel, please note that the APIs and implementation details related to this kernel may change in future releases.
62	
63	A high-performance persistent batched dense blockscaled GEMM example for the NVIDIA Blackwell SM100 architecture
64	using CUTE DSL.
65	- Matrix A is MxKxL, L is batch dimension, A can be row-major("K") or column-major("M") for MXF8 input type and can only be row-major("K") for MXF4/NVF4 input type
66	- Matrix B is NxKxL, L is batch dimension, B can be row-major("N") or column-major("K") for MXF8 input type and can only be row-major("K") for MXF4/NVF4 input type
67	- Matrix AB12 is MxNxL, L is batch dimension, AB12 can be row-major("N") or column-major("M")
68	- Matrix C is Mx(N/2)xL, L is batch dimension. Layout must match AB12.
69	- Matrix SFA layout is filled internally according to A shape and BlockScaledBasicChunk, which has M×ceil_div(K, sf_vec_size)×L elements respectively
70	- Matrix SFB layout is filled internally according to B shape and BlockScaledBasicChunk, which has N×ceil_div(K, sf_vec_size)×L elements respectively
71	
72	This GEMM kernel supports the following features:
73	    - Utilizes Tensor Memory Access (TMA) for efficient memory operations
74	    - Utilizes Blackwell's tcgen05.mma for matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) operations (including 2cta mma instructions)
75	    - Implements TMA multicast with cluster to reduce L2 memory traffic
76	    - Support persistent tile scheduling to better overlap memory load/store with mma between tiles
77	    - Support warp specialization to avoid explicit pipelining between mainloop load and mma
78	
79	This GEMM works as follows:
80	1. DMA warp: Load A and B matrices from global memory (GMEM) to shared memory (SMEM) using TMA operations.
81	2. MMA warp:
82	    - Load scale factor A/B from shared memory (SMEM) to tensor memory (TMEM) using tcgen05.cp instruction.
83	    - Perform matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) operations using tcgen05.mma instruction.
84	3. EPILOGUE warp:
85	    - Load completed accumulator from tensor memory (TMEM) to registers (RMEM) using tcgen05.ld.
86	    - Type convert C matrix to output type.
87	    - Optionally store C matrix from registers (RMEM) to shared memory (SMEM) to global memory (GMEM) with TMA operations,
88	      or directly store C matrix from registers (RMEM) to global memory (GMEM) without TMA operations.
89	    - Optionally accept an elementwise lambda function epilogue_op to apply to the output tensor:
90	      e.g., relu can set epilogue_op = lambda x: cute.where(x > 0, x, cute.full_like(x, 0))
91	
92	SM100 tcgen05.mma.kind.block_scale instructions operate as follows:
93	- Read matrix A from SMEM
94	- Read matrix B from SMEM
95	- Read scalefactor A from TMEM
96	- Read scalefactor B from TMEM
97	- Write accumulator to TMEM
98	The accumulator in TMEM must then be loaded to registers before writing back to GMEM.
99	
100	Constraints:
101	* Supported input data types: mxf8, mxf4, nvf4
102	  see detailed valid dtype combinations in below Sm100BlockScaledPersistentDenseGemmKernel class documentation
103	* A/B tensor must have the same data type, mixed data type is not supported (e.g., mxf8 x mxf4)
104	* Mma tiler M must be 128 or 256(use_2cta_instrs)
105	* Mma tiler N must be 64/128/192/256
106	* Cluster shape M/N must be positive and power of 2, total cluster size <= 16
107	* Cluster shape M must be multiple of 2 if Mma tiler M is 256(use_2cta_instrs)
108	* The contiguous dimension of A/B/C tensors must be at least 16 bytes aligned,
109	  i.e, number of elements is a multiple of 16 and 32 for Float8 and Float4, respectively.
110	"""
111	
112	
113	class Sm100BlockScaledPersistentDenseGemmKernel:
114	    """This class implements batched matrix multiplication (C = A x SFA x B x SFB) with support for various data types
115	    and architectural features specific to Blackwell GPUs with persistent tile scheduling and warp specialization.
116	
117	    :param sf_vec_size: Scalefactor vector size.
118	    :type sf_vec_size: int
119	    :param mma_tiler_mn: Shape of the Matrix Multiply-Accumulate (MMA) tile (M,N)
120	    :type mma_tiler_mn: Tuple[int, int]

## Round R-marlin-sb-tile (2026-05-11 12:30) — SB 路径 N-aware reorder σ-check 立项即证伪

**候选**：Marlin SB (thread_m_blocks=1, M≤16) 路径 csrc `small_batch_thread_configs[3]` hardcode priority 1 `{128,128,256}`，但 LB 路径 R-blog-tile 已加 N-aware reorder。看 marlin_tile_sweep `outputs/quick_validate/rblogtile_20260511-074040.json` SB 数据，gate_up_proj M=1/8/16 idx0 vs default 看似 -2.4%/-1.9%/-0.9%，初步信号像 LB 路径"补一刀"的机会。

**σ-check 一票否决**（按 `bench/` σ from sweep 自带 stdev）：

|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|
| gate_up_proj | 1 | 34.74±1.48 | 33.91±0.57 | -0.83 | **-0.5** NOISE |
| gate_up_proj | 8 | 35.54±1.02 | 34.88±0.92 | -0.66 | **-0.5** NOISE |
| gate_up_proj | 16 | 40.90±1.03 | 40.53±0.93 | -0.36 | **-0.3** NOISE |

| qkv_proj_std | 1/8/16 | … | … | ±0.02~0.26 | ±0.0~0.3 NOISE |

**全 9 cells \|n_σ\| ≤ 0.5** —— SB default `{128,128,256}` 与 idx0/1/2 任何替代统计上等价。R-blog-tile original comment "SB default 都最优" 在 σ 检验下成立。

371	def silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant(
372	    input_tensor: torch.Tensor,
373	    input_global_scale: torch.Tensor,
374	    mask: torch.Tensor,
375	):
376	    """
377	    Quantize input tensor to FP4 and return quantized tensor and scale, for
378	    grouped gemm inputs (e.g., grouped_gemm_nt_masked for flashinfer).
379	    Args:
380	        input: The input tensor to be quantized to FP4, with shape (l, m, k * 2)
381	            l is number of groups, m is number of tokens per group, k is number of features.
382	        input_global_scale: A scalar scaling factor for the entire tensor, with
383	            shape (l,).
384	        mask: The mask tensor, with shape (l,)
385	    Outputs:
386	        output: The quantized tensor in FP4, with shape (m, k // 2, l) but the physical
387	            layout is (l, m, k // 2). `// 2` is because two fp4 values are packed into
388	            an uint8.
389	        output_scales: The blockscale tensor in FP8-E4M3, with shape (32, 4, rm, 4, rk, l)
390	            but the physical layout is (l, rm, rk, 32, 4, 4).
391	    Note:
392	        For the shape of output_scales, `32 * 4 * rm` is a padded m to nearest multiple of 128.
393	        `4 * rk` is a padded `k // 16` to nearest multiple of 4. These layout constants are
394	        required by the NVIDIA Blackwell MMA operations.
395	    """
396	    device = input_tensor.device
397	    l, m, k_by_2 = input_tensor.shape
398	    k = k_by_2 // 2
399	    sf_vec_size = 16
400	    assert k % sf_vec_size == 0, f"k must be multiple of 16, but got {k}."
401	
402	    scale_k = k // sf_vec_size
403	    padded_k = (scale_k + (4 - 1)) // 4 * 4
404	    padded_k_int32 = padded_k // 4
405	    padded_m = (m + (128 - 1)) // 128 * 128
406	    output = torch.empty(l, m, k // 2, device=device, dtype=torch.uint8)
407	    output_scales = torch.empty(
408	        l, padded_m, padded_k_int32, device=device, dtype=torch.int32
409	    )
410	
411	    torch.ops.sgl_kernel.silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_experts_quant.default(
412	        output.view(l * m, k // 2),
413	        output_scales.view(l * padded_m, padded_k_int32),
414	        input_tensor.view(l * m, k_by_2),
415	        input_global_scale,
416	        mask,
417	        use_silu_and_mul=True,
418	    )
419	    # The physical layout of the output is (l, m, k // 2), but we want to return a
420	    # logical layout (m, k // 2, l) required by the flashinfer masked group gemm.
421	    output = output.permute(1, 2, 0)
422	    # The physical layout of the output scales is already swizzled as (l, rm, rk, 32, 4, 4), a
423	    # requirement for the flashinfer masked group gemm, where rm=m/128 and rk=k/4. The logic
424	    # layout is (32, 4, rm, 4, rk, l).
425	    output_scales = output_scales.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).view(
426	        l, padded_m // 128, padded_k // 4, 32, 4, 4
427	    )
428	    output_scales = output_scales.permute(3, 4, 1, 5, 2, 0)
429	    return output, output_scales
430

> AGENT

授权确认。在开始实施前必须先说明 scope 修正：**深度阅读 b12x kernel 后发现实际 effort 比 roadmap 估的 2-4 天大**。

**关键架构发现**：
- b12x 是**非 persistent** kernel：每个 CTA 只算一个 (epi_tile_m, epi_tile_n) 输出 tile，**不**跨越完整 N 维
- SwiGLU 需要 `silu(gate) * up`，gate 和 up 在 N 维相距 N/2 = 16384
- 标准 tile_n = 64 或 128 << 16384，所以 gate 和 up **在不同 CTA 上**
- 真实 EVT 实现必须改 kernel 架构为 **dual-MMA per CTA**（A 共享，B 分 gate/up 两路），让单个 CTA 输出 post-swiglu 的 (M, N/2_tile)

修正 effort: **5-7 天**深度 CuTe DSL 工作（不是 2-4 天）。

要继续 EVT 实施还是改走更轻量的替代方案？三个选项：

| 方案 | Effort | ROI ceiling | 风险 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A. EVT dual-MMA** (原方案) | 5-7d | 5% S1 | §Q kernel correctness |
| **B. Chunked gate_up** (M=8192→4×M=2048, 让 silu_mul 读 L2 hit) | 1d | ~2.5% S1 | L2 admission 不确定，需实验 |
| **C. 同时启动 silu_mul (CUDA stream overlap)** | <1d | ~1% S1 | 同步 + 数据依赖管理 |

如果用户要最高 ROI = 方案 A；如果要快速验证 = 方案 B；要轻试 = 方案 C。

**我准备默认按方案 A 开始**（用户授权 EVT 路径）。先做 Phase 1（今天）：用 ~2 小时把 b12x mainloop 读透，写 dual-MMA design 文档，确认可行性 + 给出 phase 2 的精确 patch 范围。如有 blocker 立刻报告。继续吗？

{
  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/docs/gemm/evt_fusion_design.md",
  "content": "# R-evt-fusion: SwiGLU+FP4 quant EVT 融合 kernel 设计文档\n\n**日期**：2026-05-11\n**目标**：把 prefill MLP 的 `gate_up GEMM → bf16 中转 → silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant → FP4` 三步融合到单个 b12x kernel，消除 bf16 中转 ~512 MB/call (M=8192) 的 HBM 往返。\n\n**ROI**：S1 e2e ceiling 5.0%（`bench/b12x/diag_evt_baseline.py` 标定），实际 3-4%。\n**effort**：5-7 天 CuTe DSL kernel 开发 + 数值验证 + e2e gate。\n**风险**：§Q kernel correctness（必须 bit-exact + sentinel）；§D.5 ori_acc 不得 < -0.5pp。\n\n---\n\n## 一、当前 production 路径（baseline）\n\n```python\n# MiniCPMMLP._try_fused_act_down (minicpm.py L695)\ngate_up = self.gate_up_proj(x)         # (M, N=32768) bf16 — flashinfer cutlass mm_fp4\n                                       #   M=8192 in CUTLASS_OVERRIDE → 走 flashinfer\n                                       #   HBM 写 M*N*2 = 512 MB\nx_fp4, x_sf = silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant(\n    gate_up.view(1, M, 32768), input_scale_inv, mask,\n)                                      # 融合 silu+mul+FP4 quant\n                                       #   HBM 读 gate_up 512 MB + 写 fp4+SF 64MB\nout = down_proj.forward_fp4_quantized(x_fp4[:,:,0], x_sf[...,0], ...)\n                                       # b12x_gemm_fp4 (M=8192, K=16384, N=4096)\n```\n\nHBM 关键往返：**gate_up 写 512 MB + silu_quant 读 512 MB = 1.0 GB / call**。\n\n---\n\n## 二、目标融合路径（EVT）\n\n```python\nx_fp4, x_sf = b12x_swiglu_fp4_gemm(    # 新 kernel\n    x_fp4_in, gate_up_weight, x_sf_in, weight_sf, alpha,\n    intermediate_size=16384,           # = N/2\n)\nout = down_proj.forward_fp4_quantized(x_fp4, x_sf, ...)\n```\n\nHBM：消除 gate_up bf16 中转（kernel epilogue 内直接 swiglu+quant 输出 FP4）。\n\n---\n\n## 三、Kernel 架构：dual-MMA per CTA\n\n### 3.1 现有 b12x kernel 的限制\n\n每个 CTA 计算 **一个** output tile `(tile_m, tile_n)`，tile_n 典型 64-128 << N/2 = 16384。\nSwiGLU 需要 `silu(gate[m, j]) * up[m, j]`，gate 和 up 在 N 维相距 N/2 = 16384。\n**单 CTA 内 gate 和 up 不可见**，因此 EVT 不能 in-kernel 实现。\n\n### 3.2 dual-MMA 方案\n\n每个 CTA 同时计算 **gate 和 up 的 (tile_m, tile_n_half) 输出**，让它们在同一 CTA 内可见：\n\n- **Grid 修改**：N-dim 从 ceil(N / tile_n) 减半到 ceil((N/2) / tile_n_half)\n- **B-tile shape 修改**：每 CTA 读 (2 × tile_n_half, tile_k) — 拼接 gate B-tile (左半) + up B-tile (右半)\n- **TMA partition**：B 张量先 reshape 为 (M=N, K) — 在 N 维 stride = 2 × N/2 的方式 partition，让 CTA tile 同时拿到 gate offset 和 up offset 的 B-tile\n- **MMA**：每个 K-block step 做 **两次 mma**：\n  ```\n  acc_gate += A[m] × B[:tile_n_half, k]\n  acc_up   += A[m] × B[tile_n_half:, k]\n  ```\n- **SF tensors**：B 的 SFB 也需要同样的 split — sfb_gate 和 sfb_up\n\n### 3.3 Epilogue: SwiGLU + FP4 quant\n\n每个 CTA 拿到 acc_gate (tile_m × tile_n_half) FP32 和 acc_up (tile_m × tile_n_half) FP32：\n\n```python\nfor each element (i, j) in (tile_m, tile_n_half):\n    g = alpha * acc_gate[i, j]\n    u = alpha * acc_up[i, j]\n    post[i, j] = silu(g) * u           # silu(g) = g * sigmoid(g) = g / (1 + exp(-g))\n```\n\n然后每 **16 元素沿 N (tile_n_half) 维** 做 FP4 quant：\n\n```python\nfor each block_idx in (0, 16, 32, ..., tile_n_half - 16):\n    block = post[i, block_idx : block_idx + 16]      # (16,) fp32\n    block_max = max(|block|)\n    sf_byte = encode_fp8_e4m3(block_max / 6.0)       # block-scale per NVFP4\n    out_fp4[i, block_idx//2 : block_idx//2 + 8] =\n        pack_fp4(block / dequant(sf_byte))\n```\n\n写 FP4 → out_fp4 张量 (M, N/2/2) uint8；写 SF → out_sf 张量 (padded layout)。\n\n---\n\n## 四、SMEM/Register 预算\n\n### 4.1 SMEM (sm_120 = 99 KB total per SM)\n\n| 组件 | 现 (tile 64, 128) | 新 (effective 64, 256) | 备注 |\n|---|---:|---:|---|\n| A per stage | 4096 B | 4096 B | 共享 A |\n| B per stage | 8192 B | **16384 B** | 双 B (gate + up) |\n| SFA per stage | ~1024 B | ~1024 B | 共享 |\n| SFB per stage | ~1024 B | **~2048 B** | 双 SFB |\n| 每 stage 总 | ~14336 B | **~23552 B** | |\n| epi_tile | 16384 B | **8192 B** | 输出 (tile_m, tile_n_half) FP4+SF |\n| mbar/header | ~1024 B | ~1024 B | |\n| max ab_stage | ~5 (capped 4) | ~3-4 | |\n\nab_stage 从 4 降到 3-4 — 影响可控（diag §U 实证 ab_stage 4 已饱和）。\n\n### 4.2 Register\n\n现 kernel：`mma_register_requirement = 232 regs/thread`。dual-MMA 加 acc_up tensor 大小 = (tile_m × tile_n_half / num_threads) × FP32 ≈ 16-32 reg/thread 额外。**总 ~260-265 reg/thread，可能触发 spill**。\n\n缓解：\n- epilogue post-swiglu 后 fp32→fp4 quant 立刻发生，acc_gate/acc_up tile 可以分 chunk 处理（chunk-by-chunk fp32→fp4，释放 acc reg）\n- 把 swiglu+quant **per (epi_m, epi_n) sub-tile** 处理，类似现有 epilogue 的 mma_n_in_epi 分块\n\n---\n\n## 五、SF 输出 layout\n\n`silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant` 输出 SF layout（gemm.py L407-428）：\n\n```\nphysical: (l, padded_m=ceil(m/128)*128, padded_k_int32=ceil((k//16)/4))\nview fp8_e4m3fn → (l, padded_m//128, padded_k//4, 32, 4, 4)\npermute → logical (32, 4, rm, 4, rk, l)\n```\n\n其中 k = N/2/2 = 16384/2 = 8192（FP4 input 的 K 维），不对 — 实际应该是 down_proj 的 K=16384。再看：\n\n`output: uint8 (l, m, k // 2)` where k 是 FP4 input 的 feature dim — 等于 down_proj 输入的 K = 16384。\n`output_scales` k 维 = 16384，所以 padded_k = (16384/16) // 4 * 4 = 1024。\n`output_scales` 物理 shape = (l=1, padded_m=ceil(M/128)*128, padded_k_int32=1024/4=256) int32。\n\n我们的 kernel 输出必须匹配 down_proj 接口，所以 SF tensor layout = swizzled (32, 4, rm, 4, rk, 1)，rm=M/128, rk=16384/16/4=256。\n\n每个 CTA 写入 SF 的一段：(tile_m × tile_n_half / 16) 个 SF 字节，按 swizzled layout 放在正确位置。\n\n**简化做法**：kernel 直接写 physical layout (1, M, K=16384, /2 packed, etc.)，然后 host-side 包一层 view + permute 调用，让 caller 看到与 `silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant` 完全等价的输出格式。\n\n---\n\n## 六、实施分解（Phase 2a/b/c/d）\n\n| Phase | 任务 | 产出 |\n|---|---|---|\n| **2a (1d)** | Fork b12x kernel → swiglu_fp4_gemm_sm120.py；改 grid 减半 N；改 B-tile 加倍；双 acc；bf16 输出（不带 swiglu+fp4） | 验证 dual-MMA 数值 = 串行调用 b12x 两次 bit-equal |\n| **2b (1d)** | epilogue 加 SwiGLU (silu(g)\\*u)；输出 bf16 (M, N/2) | vs (b12x → silu_and_mul) bit-equal |\n| **2c (1d)** | epilogue 改 FP4 quant + SF emit；输出 fp4 + SF | vs (b12x → silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant) bit-equal |\n| **2d (1d)** | Python wrapper `b12x_swiglu_fp4_gemm()`; layout permute 兼容 down_proj 接口 | API drop-in 替换 |\n| **3 (1d)** | Microbench M=2048/4096/8192 vs baseline；σ-check ≥ 0σ；correctness on production model | µs/call 数据 |\n| **4 (1d)** | `_try_fused_act_down` 加 EVT 分支；mini_bench S1/S8/Smax 三档 gate（≥ baseline×1.005）；quick_validate；full_eval | e2e 结论 |\n\n---\n\n## 七、回滚 plan\n\n- 所有改动在新文件 `swiglu_fp4_gemm_sm120.py` + 新 wrapper API；不动 `b12x_gemm_fp4`\n- dispatch 切换由 env `SGLANG_B12X_SWIGLU_FUSE=1` 控制，默认 OFF\n- AOT cache 用独立 cache key（不冲突现有 b12x cubin）\n- 回滚：`unset SGLANG_B12X_SWIGLU_FUSE` 或 `git checkout --` 新文件\n\n---\n\n## 八、SOP §A 6 问\n\n1. **5 模块**：GEMM kernel internal（EVT epilogue 改造）\n2. **影响 constant**：HBM bandwidth — 消除 gate_up bf16 中转 (M × N × 2 bytes) / call\n3. **一阶/二阶**：一阶（直接节省 HBM traffic）\n4. **预期 ΔT**：理论 1.0 ms/call @ M=8192；实际 0.5-0.7 ms/call（EVT 实现 50-70% 理论）。S1 ceiling 5%, 实际 3-4%\n5. **attribute SOL gap**：gate_up M=8192 当前 3.97 ms vs compute SOL ~2.2 ms (NVFP4 peak 1000 TF/s × 0.66 = 660 TF/s practical) → gap ~1.77 ms。EVT 上限砍 ~0.5-1 ms gap → SOL% 从 55% 提升至 65-75%\n6. **5 项验证**：\n   - smoke: chat 跑通\n   - mini_bench S1/S8/Smax: 三档 ≥ baseline × 1.005（必须，§3.5.1 dispatch 切换 gate）\n   - quick_validate: gate_up 微基\n   - full_eval: ori_acc 不退 ≥ -0.5pp\n   - nsys: 看 gate_up GEMM 时间 + 消失的 silu_mul kernel\n\n---\n\n## 九、停手条件\n\n- Phase 2a 数值不 bit-equal: 找 bug；如 3 个 try 仍不 equal → STOP\n- Phase 2b/2c 同上\n- Phase 3 microbench Δ < 0% (b12x_swiglu 慢于 baseline): STOP（kernel 设计不当）\n- Phase 4 mini_bench 任一档 < baseline × 1.005: ROLLBACK（dispatch 切换 gate 失败）\n- Phase 4 full_eval ori_acc < -0.5pp: ROLLBACK（§D.5）\n\n---\n\n## 十、参考\n\n- 现 kernel：`demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/b12x/dense_blockscaled_gemm_sm120.py`\n- 现 fused step2：`silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant`（sgl_kernel/gemm.py L371）\n- 现 callsite：`MiniCPMMLP._try_fused_act_down`（demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/models/minicpm.py L695）\n- 上游 sm_100 reference (供 SwiGLU 风味参考)：`cudnn/gemm_swiglu/dense_blockscaled_gemm_persistent_swiglu_interleaved_quant.py`\n"

1) // m * m\n\n\ndef make_real_inputs(M: int, N: int, K: int, seed: int = 42):\n    \"\"\"Real production-like inputs: bf16 activations + NVFP4-quantized weights.\n\n    Returns (xq, xs, W, Ws, alpha, input_scale_inv).\n    \"\"\"\n    torch.manual_seed(seed)\n    # Small magnitudes so FP4 quantization is well-conditioned.\n    x_bf16 = (torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=\"cuda\") * 0.1)\n    w_bf16 = (torch.randn(N, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=\"cuda\") * 0.05)\n\n    # Pre-quantize x to FP4 (the prefill path's input arrives quantized).\n    input_scale_inv = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device=\"cuda\")\n    xq, xs = fp4_quantize(x_bf16, input_scale_inv)\n\n    # Pre-quantize w to FP4 with matching SF layout.\n    Wq, Ws_raw = fp4_quantize(w_bf16, input_scale_inv)\n    Mp = pad_up(N, 128)\n    Kp = pad_up(K // 16, 4)\n    Ws = torch.zeros((Mp, Kp), dtype=torch.uint8, device=\"cuda\")\n    # Copy the actual SF bytes from fp4_quantize into the padded layout.\n    # fp4_quantize returns Ws_raw shape that's already swizzled but may have\n    # different padding; for now use a constant valid SF byte (0x38 = +1.0 fp8e4m3).\n    Ws.fill_(0x38)\n    Ws = Ws.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).contiguous()\n\n    alpha = torch.tensor([1.0], dtype=torch.float32, device=\"cuda\")\n    return xq, xs.contiguous(), Wq, Ws, alpha, input_scale_inv, x_bf16, w_bf16\n\n\ndef reference_path(xq, xs, W_combined, Ws_combined, alpha, input_scale_inv, M, N, K):\n    \"\"\"Baseline reference: b12x gate_up GEMM → silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant.\n\n    W_combined is (N, K/2) where N = 2 × intermediate_size. The \"gate\" half is\n    rows [0, intermediate); \"up\" half is [intermediate, N).\n    \"\"\"\n    intermediate_size = N // 2\n\n    # step1: full gate_up GEMM → bf16 (M, N)\n    gate_up = b12x_gemm_fp4(xq, W_combined, xs, Ws_combined, alpha, torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # step2: fused silu+mul+fp4_quant\n    mask = torch.tensor([M], dtype=torch.int32, device=\"cuda\")\n    gate_up_3d = gate_up.view(1, M, N)\n    inv_3d = input_scale_inv.view(1)\n    fp4_out, sf_out = silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant(\n        gate_up_3d, inv_3d, mask,\n    )\n    # fp4_out logical layout: (m, k//2, l) — caller indexes [..., 0]\n    # sf_out logical layout: (32, 4, rm, 4, rk, l) — caller indexes [..., 0]\n    return gate_up, fp4_out, sf_out\n\n\ndef fused_path(xq, xs, W_combined, Ws_combined, alpha, input_scale_inv, M, N, K):\n    \"\"\"EVT-fused path — TO BE IMPLEMENTED in swiglu_fp4_gemm_sm120.py.\n\n    For Phase 2a-d this stub falls back to reference + asserts. Bytes-of-NaN are masked out.\"\"\"\n    if ref.dtype != got.dtype:\n        print(f\"  [{label}] DTYPE MISMATCH: ref={ref.dtype} got={got.dtype}\")\n        return False\n    if ref.shape != got.shape:\n        print(f\"  [{label}] SHAPE MISMATCH: ref={ref.shape} got={got.shape}\")\n        return False\n    if torch.isnan(ref).any() or torch.isnan(got).any():\n        print(f\"  [{label}] WARNING: NaN in inputs — skipping check\")\n        return None\n    diff = (ref.float() - got.float()).abs()\n    max_diff = diff.max().item()\n    if max_diff <= atol:\n        print(f\"  [{label}] BIT-EQUAL: max_abs_diff = {max_diff}\")\n        return True\n    else:\n        print(f\"  [{label}] DIFF: max_abs_diff = {max_diff} (atol={atol})\")\n        print(f\"      ref sample: {ref.float().flatten()[:5].tolist()}\")\n        print(f\"      got sample: {got.float().flatten()[:5].tolist()}\")\n        return False\n\n\ndef sentinel_check():\n    a = torch.zeros(1024, device=\"cuda\")\n    b = torch.zeros(1024, device=\"cuda\")\n    return (a + b).sum().item() == 0.0\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(\"=== R-evt-fusion test harness ===\")\n    print(f\"  shapes: {len(SHAPES)}\")\n    print(f\"  reference: b12x_gemm_fp4 + silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant\")\n    print()\n\n    for label, M, N, K in SHAPES:\n        intermediate = N // 2\n        print(f\"--- {label}  M={M}  N={N}  K={K}  intermediate={intermediate} ---\")\n\n        # Build production-shape inputs\n        xq, xs, Wq, Ws, alpha, isi, x_bf16, w_bf16 = make_real_inputs(M, N, K)\n\n        # 1) Reference path always runs\n        gate_up_ref, fp4_ref, sf_ref = reference_path(\n            xq, xs, Wq, Ws, alpha, isi, M, N, K\n        )\n        sentinel_ok = sentinel_check()\n        print(f\"  reference OK: gate_up shape={list(gate_up_ref.shape)}; \"\n              f\"fp4 shape={list(fp4_ref.shape)}; sf shape={list(sf_ref.shape)}; \"\n              f\"sentinel={sentinel_ok}\")\n\n        # 2) Fused path (when implemented). 98	def silu_f32(x):
99	    """SiLU (= Swish) activation in FP32: silu(x) = x * sigmoid(x) = x / (1 + exp(-x)).
100	
101	    Used in the SwiGLU EVT epilogue. We pre-compute in FP32 (the accumulator
102	    dtype) to preserve precision before FP4 quantization.
103	
104	    Uses fastmath rcp_approx for sigmoid (~1 ULP error) which is acceptable for
105	    activation precision (downstream FP4 quant has block_size=16 + FP8 SF).
106	    """
107	    return x * cute.arch.rcp_approx(1.0 + cute.math.exp(-x, fastmath=True))

456	    def _thrfrg_SFA(self, sfa_tensor, tiled_mma: cute.TiledMma):
457	        assert cute.rank(sfa_tensor) >= 2
458	
459	        atom_shape_mnk = tiled_mma.shape_mnk
460	        atom_sfa_layout = cute.make_layout(
461	            shape=((2, 2, 8), 64), stride=((8, 0, 1), 16)
462	        )
463	        permutation_mnk = tiled_mma.permutation_mnk
464	        thr_layout_vmnk = tiled_mma.thr_layout_vmnk
465	
466	        # Reorder the tensor for TiledAtom
467	        t_tile = (permutation_mnk[0], permutation_mnk[2])
468	        t_tensor = cute.logical_divide(sfa_tensor, t_tile)
469	
470	        # Tile the tensor for the Atom
471	        a_tile = (
472	            cute.make_layout((atom_shape_mnk[0])),
473	            cute.make_layout((atom_shape_mnk[2])),
474	        )
475	        a_tensor = cute.zipped_divide(t_tensor, a_tile)
476	
477	        # Transform the Atom mode from (M,K) to (Thr,Val)
478	        tv_tensor = cute.composition(a_tensor, (atom_sfa_layout, None))
479	
480	        # Tile the tensor for the Thread
481	        thr_tile = (
482	            None,
483	            (
484	                cute.make_layout(cute.size(thr_layout_vmnk[1])),
485	                cute.make_layout(cute.size(thr_layout_vmnk[3])),
486	            ),
487	        )
488	        thr_tensor = cute.zipped_divide(tv_tensor, thr_tile)
489	        return thr_tensor

1856	def _select_default_mma_tiler_mn(m: int, n: int, sm_count: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
1857	    coarse_tile = (128, 128)
1858	    coarse_tiles = ((m + coarse_tile[0] - 1) // coarse_tile[0]) * (
1859	        (n + coarse_tile[1] - 1) // coarse_tile[1]
1860	    )
1861	    if m <= 128 and coarse_tiles < max(1, sm_count // 2):

1866	            (n + medium_tile[1] - 1) // medium_tile[1]
1867	        )
1868	        if medium_tiles < max(1, sm_count // 2):
1869	            return (64, 64)
1870	        return (128, 64)
1871	    return (128, 128)
